businessRules.ruleTitle: Meta returns the context rules for each data section
event.id is generated once an event is recorded with a event.status.code=complete

If request contains ADP-Act-As-OrgOID, ADP-Act-As-AssociateOID and ADP-Acting-SessionID header values, SOR MUST use ADP-Act-As-AssociateOID header value to authorize the data requested, NOT associateoid header value to authorize the data.

/data/input is optional.  Input communicates data that is needed to complete recording the event instance.  An example is a benefits.enroll event.  The input communicates the benefitOfferings (the choices) that the user has to make which are communicated in the transform.
An event which is being recorded includes the /data/eventContext and the /data/transform during the composition phase (i.e. recording of the event).
If there is no effective date from a business perspective then the effective date should be set equal to the record date time.
An event instance which has been recorded has an event.status.code=complete
An event instance may be created by a System of record for a user to complete. This event instance will have a event.status.code=created
A self link is included in the /data/links with 1 links item with the following 2 properties: rel=”self” href=”/events-notifications/{domain}/v1/{event-name}/{eventID}”
/data/schemaContext communicates the keys and properties that relate the event instance to a concrete concept (e.g. associate).
An event notification does not include the transform or meta objects.
effectiveDateTime is the date that the event is effective from a business perspective
If the event is declared by an actor then the creationDateTime is the date time when the first call is made to the System of Record.
The recordDateTime is the date time which the event is recorded in the system of record with an event.status.code=complete
/data/output communicates the result of the event instance.
The only information that must be valued in the meta for the events header are the standard codelist references for priorityCode, eventStatusCode, and serviceCategoryCode
/data/output may be provided during the recording of the event showing the intermediary results.

If request contains ADP-On-Behalf-Of-OrgOID, ADP-On-Behalf-Of-AssociateOID and ADP-Acting-SessionID header values, SOR MUST use ADP-On-Behalf-Of-AssociateOID header value to authorize the data requested, NOT associateoid header value to authorize the data.
All envelope data is set by the System of Record (e.g. event.ID, creationDateTime, recordDateTime, event.status.code, etc…
A complete event has /data/eventContext and /data/output
An event instance which is being “worked on” has an event.status.code=inprogress
An event notification includes the /data/eventContext and /data/output objects.
For Act-As or On-Behalf-Of requests, header 'Cache-Control: no-store' MUST be set to indicate on server or on UI the response object SHOULD not be cached
creationDateTime is the date that the event is created.  If a System of Record creates the event instance then it sets the creationDateTime.
/data/transform is only used during the recording of the event.  The transform is the data that is provided by a user/machine to complete the recording of the event.

An SOR may return an HTTP 503 when they are down for a scheduled maintenance or for an outage.If an SOR is planning a maintenance window then they should plan on having an end point available to return the 503 with a standard confirmMessage.  The confirmMessage will contain a message stating the date and timeframe that the maintenance window is for.The SOR should return the Retry-After response-header field with the Date and Time when they expect the system to be available.  E.g. §  Retry-After: Fri, 31 Dec 1999 23:59:59 GMT  This does not need to be handled dynamically.  They can set the time that their maintenance window ends.

The Work Assignment API updates the work assignments for a worker. Below are the few scenarios with different set of filter conditions of 400 status code.

Condition

Message Text

Update work assignment details with an invalid associateOID (Associate Object ID).

"userMessage": { "messageTxt": "associateOID is invalid." }

Update work assignment details with an invalid workAssignmentID.

"userMessage": { "messageTxt": "workAssignmentID is invalid."

Update work assignment details with an invalid codeValue for the job change reason.

"userMessage": { "messageTxt": "/events/data/transform/workers/workAssignment/eventReasonCode/codeValue is invalid." }

Update work assignment details with an invalid effectiveDate.

"userMessage": { "messageTxt": "transform/ effectiveDateTime is not a valid date. Enter the date in the format yyyy-MM-dd."}

Update work assignment details with an invalid wageLawcoverage (Fair Labor Standards Act - FLSA).

"userMessage": { "messageTxt": "/events/data/transform/workers/workAssignment/wageLawCoverage is invalid." }

Update work assignment details with invalid position start date.

"userMessage": { "messageTxt": "An employee's position start date must be greater than or equal to the effective hire date (the greater of the hire date or the rehire date)." }

Update work assignment details with an invalid Job Title.

"userMessage": {"messageTxt": "/events/data/transform/workers/workAssignment/jobTitle is invalid."}

Update work assignment details with an invalid JOB function code.

"userMessage":{"messageTxt":"/events/data/transform/workers/workAssignment /jobFunctionCode/codeValue is invalid." }

Update work assignment details with invalid NAICS (industry classification code).

"userMessage": { "messageTxt": "/events/data/transform/workers/workAssignment/industryClassifications/classificationCode is invalid." }

Update work assignment details with an invalid officerTypeCode.

"userMessage": { "messageTxt": "/events/data/transform/workers/workAssignment/officerTypeCode/codeValue is invalid." }

Update work assignment details with an invalid payGradeCode.

"userMessage": { "messageTxt": "/events/data/transform/workers/workAssignment/payGradeCode is invalid." }

Update work assignment details with invalid Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) job classificationCode.

"userMessage": { "messageTxt": "/events/data/transform/workers/workAssignment/occupationalClassifications/classificationCode (EEOC) is invalid." }

Update work assignment details with an invalid EEO Establishment.

"userMessage": { "messageTxt": "/events/data/transform/workers/work Assignment/ occupational Classifications/ classificationCode/ codeValue (EEO Establishment) is invalid." }

parameters.description: Org OID for organization of the associate that is the actor in 'Acting As' as provisioned by the ADP Registry

parameters.name: ADP-Context-ExpressionID
parameters.description: Geopolitical context, typically country, region, e.g. country=CA;subdivision=Quebec

parameters.name: sm_user
parameters.description: SiteMinder user ID.  Required for requests where conversation was initiated from a service consumer, external to ADP, and that consumer was authenticated by SMS. Example - sm_user: JJohns@Abc

parameters.name: sm_userdn
parameters.description: SiteMinder user LDAP distinguished name.  Required for requests where conversation was initiated from a service consumer, external to ADP, and that consumer was authenticated by SMS. Example - sm_userdn: uid=JJohns@Abc,ou=Users,o=Abc

parameters.name: ADP-Act-As-AssociateOID
parameters.description: Associate OID of the associate that is the actor in 'Acting As' as provisioned by the ADP Registry

parameters.name: ADP-Consumer-ApplicationID
parameters.description: Identifier of the application sending a request - not intended to be used as a correlation id for messages across systems participating in a collaboration

parameters.name: sm_transactionid
parameters.description: SiteMinder transaction ID.  Required for requests where conversation was initiated from a service consumer, external to ADP, and that consumer was authenticated by SMS. Example - sm_transactionid: 1aaf14ac-7083-54c0186f-4680c940-82b33ca3

parameters.name: SORContext
parameters.description: Context within an SOR that the call should be routed to

parameters.name: ConsumerAppOID
parameters.description: Identifier for the service consumer application.  This header is required, if the actor (Service Consumer) is an application or the actor is internal to ADP

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Accept-Language' ': ' ( language | '*' ) [';' 'q' '='qvalue]. Specifies the language(s) that are acceptable for the response. The optional qvalue represents a quality level for acceptable languages.

parameters.name: associateoid
parameters.description: Associate OID of the requestor as provisioned by the ADP Registry

parameters.name: roleCode
parameters.description: The role the user is playing during the transaction.  Possible values: employee,manager,practitioner,administrator,supervisor.  The roleCode header should be passed in all calls.

parameters.name: orgoid
parameters.description: Organization OID of the requestor as provisioned by the ADP Registry

parameters.name: sm_auth_level
parameters.description: SiteMinder autorization level.  Required for requests where conversation was initiated from a service consumer, external to ADP, and that consumer was authenticated by SMS. Example - sm_auth_level: 10

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: The identity management realm, e.g. ISI

parameters.name: SOR
parameters.description: SOR where the call is routed to - usuall injected by the API proxy, with few exceptions
